issues.description: The problem text explicitly instructs that the helper method singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) should be implemented as public for testing, but both the template and the provided solution declare this helper as private. Additionally, the UML in the problem statement indicates a private visibility for singFarmSongVerse, so the problem statement itself contains a visibility contradiction (UML vs textual instruction). This mismatch will confuse students and prevent tests or instructors from calling the helper directly as requested.
issues.suggestedFix: Resolve the visibility mismatch by making singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal) public in the template and in the reference solution so tests and students can call it as described. Also update the UML in the problem statement (or the textual instruction) so both consistently state the same visibility (preferably public as requested for testing).
